module: Main window (fg_main, "Main view") of the Flowgraph editor: menu bar (File: new project, loading via editor_fileDialog, recent files, restore, clipboard encoding...), node canvas of the current graph with drawing modes (default, simple, heatmap, geometry), colored borders according to the project state (running, paused, stopped, macro), context menus (nodes, pins, links, node creation, Quick Connect) and handling of drag and drop of nodes, macros and variables. Very large file (about 1100 lines): only the useful functions are detailed.
notes: Drag and drop creates nodes via mgr.graph:createNode: "types/getVariable" or "types/setVariable" for variables, "macro/integrated" for macros; each creation adds a history entry (fgEditor.addHistory).
Creating nodes/macros is only possible if mgr.allowEditing is true; otherwise the menu displays "Disabled.".

attach.desc: Associates the manager, prepares the border colors and sets focusGraph to the main graph.

init.desc: Initializes the context identifiers (node/pin/link), column sizes, FPS smoothing, and registers the 600x600 window.

drawMenu.desc: Draws the window's menu bar (File, etc.).

drawGraph.desc: Draws a graph (nodes and links) with a given builder and style.

drawSelf.desc: Main drawing body: window, canvas, interactions, context menus.

showQuickAccessSubmenu.desc: Displays the "Quick Connect" submenu listing the compatible pins (quickAccess, opposite direction) of the graph.

showNewNodeContextMenu.desc: Displays the node creation menu (node library) in a 300x300 child (× UI scale), or "Disabled." if editing is forbidden.

resolveDragDropPayload.desc: Handles a completed drag and drop: creates the node, macro or variable node at the mouse position, aligned to the grid.

isMouseHovering.desc: Indicates whether the mouse is inside the window rectangle.

doContextMenus.desc: Handles the opening and drawing of the context menus (node, pin, link, background) by suspending the node editor.
